evals.prompt: cascade — I just approved my ai-agents outline, let's generate the distribution content now
evals.expected_output: Claude finds both research and outline files for ai-agents, confirms once with both filenames, runs cascade with --research-file and --outline-file flags, reports output dir + Twitter hook preview + VIDEO_LINK reminder + /short-form next step suggestion.

assertions.name: finds-both-files
assertions.description: Claude identifies both the research brief (2026-05-12_ai-agents_brief.md) and the outline (2026-05-12_ai-agents.md) by name

assertions.name: single-confirmation-step
assertions.description: Claude asks for confirmation exactly once, not in multiple separate steps

assertions.name: filenames-in-confirmation
assertions.description: The confirmation message includes the actual filenames (not just the topic label)

assertions.name: correct-command-flags
assertions.description: The command uses --research-file and --outline-file flags (not just a URL)

assertions.name: twitter-hook-preview
assertions.description: After-completion report previews the Twitter hook / first tweet

assertions.name: video-link-reminder
assertions.description: Report mentions replacing [VIDEO_LINK] placeholder before posting

assertions.name: next-step-suggestion
assertions.description: Report suggests /short-form as the next pipeline step
